svg.title: SQL failover-group continuity topology
svg.desc: Topology showing an application connecting through a failover-group listener to primary and secondary Azure SQL databases with backup and replication monitoring.

g.aria-label: stable connection endpoint: application to listener
active database route: listener to primary
replication lag telemetry: secondary to health
failover decision evidence: health to listener
Service node: Replication health and RPO

svg.text: Applications use the failover-group listener while zone-redundant databases replicate across regions and expose measurable health.
